asr.full_text: hey guys I am driving this is a really not safe with so ever, but it's my birthday! happy birthday to me! let me pull off the road real quick so I don't kill myself so I wanted to do a video that I felt was very relevant right now in my life and that is all the ways you can get free stuff when your birthday so first I'm going to say that ninety percent of these places you can't just walk in on your birthday you have to be signed up for the rewards programs but they're all free I'm not going to be signing up for anything that you have to pay for like credit cards and all these other things it's gonna just be you sign up and it's like a point system but if you don't have any points as long as it's your birthday you can get something on your birthday so our first stop is for breakfast so let's go get some coffee from starbucks the Starbucks I got my Starbucks coffee it was 100% free, the trick is though thank you for holding. Sorry, one moment. Please continue to fold until... So, you have to sign up for the rewards program 7 days prior to your birthday at least. So if you sign up the last second, they're not gonna honor it. Also you will not believe, I just was gonna run into Starbucks real quick cause I just parked the car real quick. I just ran into Starbucks, and I came out and this guy is putting a boot on my tire because, my God, this is stratch off. So I was like, oh my God, please do not do that. It's my birthday, I have all these other places to go to show you where you can get furry stuff for your birthday. And he was like, I don't care! And I was like Plays, plays!! So I had to make a scene and we don't have to book retired anymore but I did promise him I would update my registration or the plates, I will get the plates updated since they are super expired . He did not boot my vehicle, so thank you thank you very much all righty on to the next place i didn't mention this before because we do not have a cinnabon where i live but if you sign up for their club cinnabon program you will get a free gift on your birthday so we went to krispy kreme donuts and on your birthday you receive a free glazed donut, by signing out for their inner circle program. I, actually, did not get any donuts, but they do give you a free donut on your birthday. Next door was the Dunkin' Donuts. I just hobbled over, and if you are a DD perks member, you receive a free beverage on your birthday from Dunkin' Donuts. So, you could go get a drink from Dunkin' Donuts. Go get a donut from Krispy Kreme, and now you're all set to go. Next, for breakfast, I stopped on over to Panera and you get a free pastry on your birthday. The great thing about Panera is they actually will honor it all month long, so you don't have to be trying to stuff your face with all this stuff on your birthday. Next, I was in the pancake mood, i went over to ihop and on your birthday if you join the pancake revolution you can get a free meal at ihop which includes pancakes. next was noodles & company. noodles & company actually used to be one of my favorite places for my birthday they used to give you a free bowl of noodles but this year it was only a crispy cookie that I did not actually take BUT yeah, this year was a free crispy cookie. I really hope next year, noodles and companies goes back to giving out actual bowls of noodles because that was THE BOMB Like I get it but noodles next was the waffle house if you are a member of their regulars program you get free waffles on your birthday alright now let's move on to lunch Einstein Bros if you sign up with them you get a free bagel on your birthday. This could also be for breakfast, but if you make a sandwich out of it, it would be kind of like lunch too. When you sign up with the Firehouse Sub Rewards program, they will give you a free medium sub on your birthday. At Au Bon Pain, you get a free meal on your birthday when you sign up to their program next was jersey mike subs and when you sign up to their program you get a free regular sub and a 22 ounce fountain drink on your birthday at jack in the box sign up for their program to get free birthday tacos okay my favorite meal of the day it's dinner time Join Fudd's E club at Fuddwreckers and get a free birthday burger on you birthday! At Red Robin members of Red Robin royalty club get a free birthday burger. They also have the impossible burger there for my plant based friends! At P.F. Ching's if you join their reward program you'll get a free appetizer or dessert on your birthday at Ruby Tuesday Sign up with an email and receive a free burger or garden bar entree on your birthday now moving on to dessert Your birthday is never complete without one Join Applebee's E-Club for a free dessert on your birthday. If you join the Arby's Birthday Club, you will get a free birthday shake. At Baskin-Robbins, if you are a member of the Baskin-Robbins Birthday Club, you'll receive a free 2.5 ounce scoop of ice cream on your birthday. Don't forget to check out Ben and Jerry's if you sign up for their chunks blunker and Receive a free scoop of ice cream on your birthday Buffalo Wild Wings also gives out free dessert on your birthday when you sign up to their rewards program Cheesecake Factory if you tell your server you will get a free scoop of ice cream on your birthday You do not need to sign up for any of the programs. Next is Chili's, if you sign up for Chili's reward program you'll get a free birthday dessert. Next is Crackle Barrel, you'll get a free dessert when you tell your server it's your birthday. No rewards, sign up if necessary. At Del Taco, you'll get a free premium shake as a member of their fan club, just sign up online Macaroni Grill if you sign up for their emails you'll get a free piece of cake on your birthday Maggie moves if you live by a Maggie moves and sign up for their slab happy email you will receive a free birthday surprise I know you all love all of garden if you sign up you will get a free birthday dessert even Pizza Hut is giving out free birthday stuff you'll receive a surprise item on your birthday at Pizza Hut at Smashburger you'll receive a free side or shake when you sign up to the smash club at TCB why you'll receive a free small yogurt when you sign up for myTCBY TGIF Fridays also has a Fridays reward program and you get a free dessert on your birthday now let's get into the goodies I will admit that most of it is for women but I'm sure men'll get a free gift on your birthday sign up with Bare-mineral's fab program and receive a free gift on your birthday benefit cosmetics will give you a FREE broarch on your birthday do contact your local benefit brow bar beauty lounge for more information with bliss when you sign up for their bliss blue rewards you will get a free surprise on your birthday nicks also does free birthday stuff you'll get a free birthday gift when is your birthday with sephora they will also give you a free gift on your birthday when you are signed up to their rewards program tart cosmetics is the same with their reward program, you will get a free gift on your birthday. Ulta, you must sign up for the ultimate rewards program to get a free gift on your birthday. Urban Decay also has a program where you will get a free gift on your birthday. Kiehl's will give you free Baum or a travel sized item when you join their kiosk rewards program and lastly if you are an Express Fran if you sign up for the Express Next Rewards account you will get a free birthday gift that is valued at at least 45 dollars on your birthday hey guys thanks so much for joining me on my birthday of all the places that you can get something free on your birthday i do want to reiterate that 90 of the places i would say 95 you are going to need to join their rewards program online and enter your birthday so that is something that tripped me off at a few of the places that i went to because i signed up but i didn't enter the birthday so they're just like oh sorry even if you're like hey but i have my id they're like we don't care so make sure you do that and you can enjoy all the great things on your birthday also a lot of them do offer birthday month things like panera you can enjoy a treat all month long and there's a few others that you can enjoy a treat all month long and there's a few others that you can enjoy all month long so you don't have to rush in for your birthday I did not go in to every single place because there's just not enough room in my stomach and we don't have gas for that like what forty-something places are on this list so I did not go to every single place but you can confirm in the comments how well I did. And let me know for your birthday. My birthday is July 22nd. Do I have any birthday twins out there? Let me know in the comments. Cancer season! All right bye! Oh, alright, bye Please visit www.youtube.com
